draft.subject: Your API rate limit question
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for your patience while I looked into your question — your ticket is still open on our side. On rate limits: API rate limits scale with plan tier, with Pro and Team getting higher limits than Starter. I'm happy to walk through what that means for your usage.

I also saw your first project is up in Wrenfield — nice. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time if you'd like a second pair of hands.

Would a short call this week help? I can answer the rate limit details live.

Best,
Chidi
